title: Prove or bound the slow Pauli χe collision spectrum using nonpolynomial IR/UV packets and time-domain evolution; then add finite SM heat and realistic portal
objective: The two-to-five FD polynomial logit Galerkin basis has no stable low spectral Ritz estimate; verify how far the true slow collision space extends and whether a positive spectral gap exists in physically relevant weighted function space, without equating Ritz, thermal-moment gamma or heavy NR drag with real χ kinetic thermalisation. In parallel construct an actual positivity- and number/energy-conserving finite-volume time evolution for nonthermal fχ and a finite SM bath.
prerequisites: Read AGENTS.md, CONTINUOUS-RESEARCH-SPEC.md, GOAL, STATE, NEXT_ACTION, EVIDENCE, BACKLOG
Verify all GitHub Actions incl commit bd776da and full PR HEAD; fix tests before scientific promotion
Read kinetics/LINEARIZED-PAULI-EIGENMODES.md, PAULI-RITZ-BASIS-AUDIT.md, higher_order_pauli_modes.py, nonlinear source and conservative event projection, full previous numerical data
predeclared_falsification: Numerically converged eigenvalues in n and cutoff do NOT imply basis convergence. Test nested polynomial dimensions beyond 5 and localized logit IR/hard-tail basis; record actual Ritz descent.

Check susceptibility and collision Dirichlet forms independently. Identify if rare high-E χ states have very weak relaxation in the full continuous EFT, and do not claim gapless/gapped without analytic bounds.
Compare linearized mode rates with early time exponential decays from directly integrated nonlinear Pauli source, after constructing a physical conservation/Pauli-preserving finite-volume timestep.

Check ν_L and e_L/e_R channel completion for G_L=G_R, distinct temperatures and effects of finite plasma mass, mediator cutoff and perturbativity; no universal constant correction over cosmic expansion.
steps: Add 6+ mode orthogonal weighted basis with stable reorthogonalization or orthogonal-polynomial recurrence; independent continuous susceptibility and endpoint localization. Include IR and far-UV compact support/trial packets.
Study nested Ritz eigenvalues vs N, n_p/n_k/CM angle, p/k cutoff and precision; fix numerical-conditioning artifacts, treat true null number direction separately.

Build conservative transition network of positive χ occupancy (fermionic mode capacity) that deposits each event to radial energy nodes and transfers −Qχ to finite SM bath. Do not claim Pauli stability from moment conservation alone; prove or empirically verify upper bound and entropy.

Evolve at short and long times for analytically thermal and nonthermal initial states, verify true kinetic heating/cooling and near-equilibrium mode rates independent of initial state, time step, angular mesh and cutoff.
Only after microkinetic and SM-sector verification consider BEST coupled 1↔2 Bose-stimulated pilot and actual Γ(T), realistic H/gstar/freezing; no 86-eV Ω/BEC/CLASS claims.
acceptance: No artificial FD PCHIP equilibrium source or hidden reservoir
Independent gamma_E and Ritz spectral vs actual nonlinear evolution comparison, quantitative uncertainty/basis limit
Particle number and energy/QSM ledger with correct mode volumes and genuine Pauli bounds in actual stepping
Explicit fixed SM bath vs finite SM bath and gauge/UV validity scopes separated
New results/negative cases saved compactly, CI checked, checkpoint/commit/push then next phase
fallback: If full true spectral analysis is too expensive, derive controlled rigorous variational bounds for one localized momentum packet and do not interpret as physical late cosmology
If finite-volume collision transfer fails conservation or quantum bounds, preserve counterexample and implement monotone bounded update with explicit collision-invariant accounting
If CI unavailable, record exact blocker, keep CLASS-ready false, do not pretend background execution
prohibited: User PC/Computer Use without approval, changing main, force-push, secret/huge artifacts, fake scientific success.
